text: Ottawa and Montreal trails: cards in Gatineau Park, the Greenbelt, Mont-Royal, Cap-Saint-Jacques, Bois-de-Liesse, Mont-Saint-Bruno, Oka, Îles-de-Boucherville and Mont Saint-Hilaire show lengths, levels and notes from the NCC, the City of Montréal, Sépaq and McGill, each linked to its source. Gatineau Park's numbered trails show whether the NCC map marks them as shared with mountain bikes.
